newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigerian Shell to supply gas for power station.
newsitem.headline: Nigerian Shell to supply gas for power station.

text.p: Shell Petroleum Development Company of Nigeria said it on Friday signed a deal to supply one of Nigeria's largest power stations with 100 million standard cubic feet of gas per day.
State-run Nigerian Gas Company has agreed to pay 5.98 naira ($0.075) per 1,000 standard cubic feet.
The deal will initially supply the southeastern Afam station from Shell's gas plants at Afam and Obigbo North.
By 1999 Shell said the gas would be drawn from what is currently being flared at oil production installations.
Another deal for five million standard cubic feet per day was signed to supply the Warri power plant.
"These long-term supply agreements give us the confidence to go ahead with projects to harness our flare gas with the knowledge that we have a secure market," said Shell spokesman Samuel Inyang.
